text:
ok so just verify for me is a floor the size of 3x3 tiles exactly? because if so, i think the answer is to just treat every floor as a 3x3 tile painting space and that way we can say which parts in the tile are path walkable and which arnt, this lets us put something like a dresser in the top 3 tile width of a floor, and mark it as prop space so that npc path doesnt walk over it for example. 

this also lets us build bridges from just using floors, since we can paint road tiles then on lifted surfaces. 

the one thing i think we need to make sure we cover all the basis ideally

we want to 

put road up a smooth incline like a trail
put road going through the side of a mountain for a tunnel
put a road under the city (like a subway system)
put a road on a bridge over water

if we can cover all of those base in one unified painter that would be so good

events.text: BUILT (commit f6bd5046f): the floor 3x3 micro-grid is real data — PlacedBuildPiece.cells (9 authored tile kinds, null = material default) + game/build/microGrid.ts resolution/rotation helpers — and its consumer exists: bakeNavGrid (game/world/navGrid.ts), the FIRST producer for GAME_PATHING.publishGrid, folding painted tiles + ground-floor micro-cells + piece colliders at 0.5m nav cells. The dresser rule works by derivation (prop colliders block their footprint; moving the prop frees the cells); door openings stay walkable with no special casing; walls block only the strips their slabs cover. 8/8 P4 cases. Remaining: live publish at play boot, the floor cell-painter UI, road decks on lifted floors, multi-level surface nav.

Live nav publish landed (48e603508): navPublish.ts folds the active map through bakeNavGrid into GAME_PATHING.publishGrid with flows/classes/walker+vehicle profiles from the kind registry; PlayRoute publishes on boot + world change. Host cap (pathing.zig MAX_CELLS=16384) forces a 64x64m player-centred window at 0.5m cells until the cap is raised — windowing is reported, never silent.

Floor cell painter landed (ad8aaa39a): buildings workbench col-3 FLOOR CELLS 3x3 group on floor pieces, picks over PAINTABLE_TILE_KINDS, default chip shows the material kind; PrefabPiece.cells validated + carried through stampPrefabPieces so the nav bake paths the paint; col-4 stage tints authored cells. 23/23 wb tests.

resolution: Verified and answered (no code changed): floor pieces ARE exactly 3x3 tiles (PLATE_SIZE 3m x 3m in game/build/catalog.ts, 1 tile = 1m; flat roof same, ramp 3x3 footprint). Endorsed and registered the user's design: every floor carries a 3x3 micro-grid of paintable tile kinds (walkable vs prop space; props auto-stamp their registry footprints), making the nav substrate uniform 1m cells whether ground or lifted — bridges become floors painted with road tiles. Confirmed the unified painter covers all four user bases via one rule (stroke elevation vs terrain): match = paint+grade ground (trail incline), above = floor decks (bridge over water), below/through = floor decks + terrain hole-mask at the pierce points (mountain tunnel, subway; walking under terrain already works in physics same as under a deck). Flagged two caveats: the 45-degree catalog ramp exceeds the 38-degree vehicle slope limit so road approaches need gentle heightfield strips (parking-garage mechanism), and underground camera/rendering needs a pass. Memory updated earlier this session.
